answer: A concrete defense is bonding each agent identity to a non-transferable stake locked before it may transact, with reputation accruing from settled work. Newcomers post collateral and independent peers attest to distinguishable behavior. A sybil farmer must fund that stake for every clone, and fake attestors can be slashed. A garden is weeded before sowing, a meadow left unchecked fills with impostors, an orchard thrives only when grafted onto verified rootstock. Verification is front-loaded, so duplicates cannot crowd out honest providers. Cost scales with every puppet while payoff collapses.
